description: Provision an AWS Ec2 ManagedPrefixList via the ACK ec2 controller. Fields mirror the ec2.services.k8s.aws/v1alpha1 ManagedPrefixList spec.

addressFamily.description:
The IP address type.

Valid Values: IPv4 | IPv6

items.description: An entry for a prefix list.

maxEntries.description: The maximum number of entries for the prefix list.

name.description:
A name for the prefix list.

Constraints: Up to 255 characters in length. The name cannot start with com.amazonaws.

region.description: AWS region for this resource (e.g. eu-west-1). Rendered as the services.k8s.aws/region annotation. Empty inherits the ACK controller's default region.
region.title: AWS region

tags.description:
The tags. The value parameter is required, but if you don't want the tag
to have a value, specify the parameter with no value, and we set the value
to an empty string.

title: AWS Ec2 ManagedPrefixList
